messages:
From: Caroline Smith <caroline.smith@quantify.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2023-03-12T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot usage unexpectedly high — request for onboarding rebate

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on our pilot. We pulled our first week of telemetry and usage is materially higher than we modeled — roughly 2.8x expected token consumption on generative routes and a handful of bursts during our integration tests. That leaves us exposed to onboarding PSAs and a higher invoice than we budgeted for this quarter.

Two asks: can Redwood provide a one-time onboarding credit to cover excess usage for the pilot month, and an overage protection (temporary discount) while we stabilize request patterns? We’re prepared to sign a revised SOW and move to a 12-month commitment if we can close this gap.

I attached the usage dump and our draft SOW for context.

Attachments: Quantify_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf); quantify_usage_mar_weekly.csv (text/csv)

Appreciate any fast-track help — we’d like to finalize billing before our finance close on Friday.

Best,
Caroline Smith
Head of Integrations | Quantify AI
caroline.smith@quantify.ai
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot usage unexpectedly high — request for onboarding rebate

Caroline —

Thanks for the quick data. I ran the rough numbers with the team and we understand the urgency. Proposed path:
- One-time credit of $175,000 applied to the first invoice to cover spike and PSA scope.
- 10% overage discount on generation routes for the first 90 days while Quantify stabilizes traffic.
- Quantify signs amended SOW and commits to a 12-month usage minimum to qualify.

I’ve put Marissa and Karthik on the thread for formal exception signoff and financial review; Grace, can you confirm CS support plan and monitoring?

I’ll attach a one-page deal summary for internal review.

Attachments: deal_summary_tessa.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Next step: if Marissa or Karthik can greenlight we’ll route to VP/CFO for exec clearance and legal for an addendum.

— Tessa

Date: 2023-03-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quantify AI — executive exception memo (VP/CFO signoff requested)

Team —

Executive summary: Quantify AI (seed-stage analytics startup) is in late-stage pilot; pilot telemetry shows token consumption ~2.8x plan driven by heavy generation during ingestion phase. They are a high-probability expansion opportunity (product-led, integrations with three of our target partners). Tessa requests a one-time credit plus temporary overage protection to avoid losing momentum.

Recommendation (business & financial rationale):
- Approve a one-time credit of $175,000 to be applied to the first invoice. This preserves the pilot, accelerates adoption, and secures a signed SOW with 12-month minimum committed spend.
- Offer a 10% overage discount for the next 90 days while engineering and CS tune usage.

Payback / risk:
- Conservative projection: incremental ARR from conversion = $450k over 12 months; payback of credit within ~4–6 months post-conversion.
- Mitigations: require amendment to SOW with minimum commit; CS-led stabilization plan (Grace) and quota-based throttles if bursts continue.
- Accounting note: credit will be booked as contra-revenue; finance to approve treatment.

Attachments include an exception memo with sensitivity scenarios and updated financials. If leadership approves, we will require DocuSign amendment + legal sign-off.

Recommended approval language for VP/CFO: “Approve one-time $175,000 onboarding credit and 10% overage discount for 90 days conditional on signed 12-month minimum SOW and CS stabilization plan.”

Attachments: exception_memo_marissa.pdf; financial_sensitivity.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
